title: Room and Visitor
author: O. M. Halloran
blurb: Casper Coldharbour, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
